C17 and C24 share related exchange-and-understanding themes but lack C04's close combination of trade, contacts, and information exchange.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the United States favors the expansion of peaceful trade with the Soviet Union","parent_excerpt":"We welcome trade that carries no political or warlike implications. An informed public opinion in both our countries is essential to the proper understanding of our discussions.","explanation":"The child reuses C04's paired machinery of broader people-to-people contacts and improved information as means of increasing mutual understanding."},{"child_excerpt":"Expanded trade between our countries could, under certain conditions, be of mutual benefit and serve to improve our relations in general.","parent_excerpt":"You propose that we develop \"normal\" trade relations as part of the \"peaceful cooperation\" of which you speak.","explanation":"Both place expanded or normalized bilateral trade inside the larger project of peaceful cooperation and improved relations."}]}
